bearerAuth.description: Session token from the identity policy (dev: POST /v1/dev/login).

gatewayCredential.description: Short-lived HS256 credential minted for the MCP gateway; audience-constrained.

cursor.description: Last applied seq; Last-Event-ID wins when both are sent

loading.summary: Work is in progress and no usable result exists yet.
loading.frontend: Show a skeleton; follow the SSE stream or poll the run.

partial.summary: Some panels, sources or tasks finished; others are still running or failed.
partial.frontend: Render what exists, label the rest; never present as complete.

complete.summary: Everything requested was produced from current data.

stale.summary: A result is shown but its source is behind (watermark older than the freshness target, or served from the last finalized snapshot).
stale.frontend: Render with the freshness warning (`asOf`, `staleSeconds`); do not publish as current.

truncated.summary: The max-rows rule cut the result; `truncation` says how and by how much.
truncated.frontend: Label as truncated or downsampled; offer a narrower query.

source_unavailable.summary: The source, semantic layer or breaker is down and there is no snapshot to serve.
source_unavailable.frontend: Show the unavailable state with `nextAction`; retry with backoff.

permission_denied.summary: Not signed in, not a member, role too low, origin not allowed or classification denies access.
permission_denied.frontend: Re-authenticate or hide the action; do not retry.

rate_limited.summary: Too many requests, queue full or too many streams; `Retry-After` and `retryAfterSeconds` give the wait.
rate_limited.frontend: Back off for Retry-After seconds; keep the same x-client-id.

insufficient_data.summary: The data cannot support the answer (CANNOT_COMPUTE, coverage gap, too few observations, vintage missing).
insufficient_data.frontend: Say what is missing; never fill with zero.

metric_uncertified.summary: The metric is a draft, validated-only or deprecated and may not be used for a certified claim.

method_unvalidated.summary: The analysis method has not passed validation (METHOD_NOT_VALIDATED, inference guard).
method_unvalidated.frontend: Label the finding as unvalidated; require acknowledgement to publish.

budget_exhausted.summary: A spend limit stopped paid work: the global USD 5 model ceiling, a workspace cap, a per-resource limit or an unknown price.
budget_exhausted.frontend: Show the budget card; historical reads still work; the owner must raise a limit.

x-sse.framing: Each frame is `id: <seq>` (domain frames, coalesced, reload_required), `event: <name>`, `data: <single-line JSON>`, blank line. `: ping` comment lines are heartbeats every 15 s of silence and carry no data.
ordering: Domain frames are delivered in strictly increasing `seq` per workspace, each exactly once on a connection.
`seq` is the workspace's committed-journal sequence: a frame is only sent after its transaction committed, so a frame never describes uncommitted state.
A `coalesced` frame replaces the events fromSeq..toSeq; no frame inside that range follows it.
resume: Send `Last-Event-ID: <last applied seq>` (EventSource does this automatically) or `?cursor=<seq>`; the server replays seq > cursor.
A cursor of 0 (or absent) starts at the beginning of the retained journal.
Clients dedupe by `id`; a replayed frame with seq <= the last applied seq is ignored.
A non-numeric cursor, a cursor beyond the head, or one older than the retained journal yields `reload_required` and the stream ends.
After `session_expired` re-authenticate and resume with the same Last-Event-ID; no events are lost.
limits: At most 6 concurrent streams per browser (credential + optional `x-client-id` header): the 7th is refused 429 + Retry-After before the stream starts.
A client whose socket stays blocked is coalesced, then disconnected after the drain timeout; it resumes with Last-Event-ID.
x-sse.authorization: Bearer token; membership is re-validated about every 5 s. A foreign or unknown workspace is the same 404 as a missing one.

events.description: Objective or settings changed; `data` carries the new workspace version.
Progressive panels: one frame per panel status change (QUERYING, READY, ERROR) with index/total.

Interpretation: a grounded finding about the run's panel results was written (one frame per finding, with index/total). Re-read `GET /v1/runs/{id}` for its statement, observation/inference label, status, limitations and skeptic notes.
A panel was added to the canvas.
A panel's spec or data revision changed; refetch its chart data.
A canvas patch applied atomically; `data` carries operationId and revision.
A marker was assigned to an agent or user.
Evidence was linked to a marker.
A lens was created, updated or deleted.
A monitor rule was created, updated, enabled or disabled.
A monitor rule fired; `data` carries the trigger outcome and data maturity.
A claim's tier or support changed.
A capsule was published (explicit publish, acknowledgements recorded).
Investigation progress: run state or cancel request changed.
An evidence graph layout was saved.
Backpressure: the client is more than `maxLag` events behind (or slow); one aggregate replaces the backlog. Refetch the views named in byType.
The cursor is invalid or expired. The stream ends. Reload state, then reconnect with cursor=currentSeq.
Token expired or membership revoked. The stream ends. Re-authenticate and resume with Last-Event-ID = lastSeq.

x-websocket.purpose: Yjs collaboration transport (ch.11: WebSocket only for Yjs). Not an HTTP route: it is an HTTP Upgrade handled by collab-ws.ts.
x-websocket.auth: Authorization bearer header, or the subprotocol `nearesis.bearer.<token>` for browsers.
x-websocket.refusals: 401 without a valid session; the same 404 for foreign and unknown workspaces (before any frame).
